independent_new_hangul_native_graphics_o.method: Independent new Hangul outline reference versus clip-aware actual native non-text foreground.

independent_source_grading_columns.method: Independent source vertical cell primitives plus original top-level, non-prose numeric glyphs in the page right grading columns; every original grading glyph must remain at its source position.
